root: ^Well, well, well… back from the dead, are we? Hah—oh. Too soon? He chuckles awkwardly, but when we don’t react, he clears his throat.

^Name’s Luke. Merchant, businessman, and, if you ask around, probably the only guy here who actually knows how to run a proper trade. If you need something—supplies, a drink, a way out of this mess—you come to me. He flashes a grin.
^And don't worry, I offer killer deals. …Okay, yeah, that one was definitely too soon.
